title: Executive-Finance Concept Registry
description: Schema for concepts/registry.json. Every concept page in the app is generated from one entry in this file. See ADR-0002.

version.description: Semver of the registry format. Bump when schema changes in a breaking way.

concepts.description: The list of concept entries. Each entry becomes one page.

id.description: kebab-case, unique, stable. Used in URLs and cross-references.

domain.description: Primary domain. Drives grouping on the concept index page.

title.description: Display title as it appears on the page.

tier.description: Core = deep treatment, usually interactive. Reference = short page.

sources.description: Books that treat this concept. Exactly one must have primary=true.

template.description: Which page template renders this entry.

component.description: Required when template=interactive. Component ID from the toolbox.

defaults.description: Initial config passed to the component. Shape depends on component. Not validated here beyond being an object.

prose_ref.description: Path to markdown file with long-form content, relative to repo root.

examples.description: Optional named scenarios that load into the component (interactive template only).

related.description: Cross-references to other concept IDs. Referential integrity checked by validator.

book.description: Book ID from books.json, or the literal 'external' for Reference-tier pages sourced from online material.

chapters.description: Chapter identifiers within the book. Strings to allow forms like '15', '19', 'Mod. 5'.

primary.description: Exactly one source per concept must be primary. Enforced by validator.
